steps: Given: Initial velocity, u = 35 m s⁻¹; final velocity at maximum height, v = 0 m s⁻¹; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻².
Required: Maximum height, h.
Formula: v² = u² + 2as; here a = −g, so h = (u² − v²)/(2g).
Substitution: h = [(35 m s⁻¹)² − (0 m s⁻¹)²]/[2 × 10 m s⁻²].
Working: h = 1225 m² s⁻² / 20 m s⁻² = 61.25 m.
Result: The maximum height reached by the ball is 61.25 m.
Given: Height at the lowest point, h₁ = 1.2 m; height at the highest point, h₂ = 2.0 m; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻²; velocity at the highest point, v₂ = 0 m s⁻¹.
Required: Maximum velocity and the position where it occurs.
Formula: By conservation of energy, mgh₁ + ½mv₁² = mgh₂ + ½mv₂².
Substitution: ½mv₁² = mg(h₂ − h₁), so v₁ = √[2g(h₂ − h₁)] = √[2 × 10 m s⁻² × (2.0 m − 1.2 m)].
Working: v₁ = √(16 m² s⁻²) = 4 m s⁻¹. The velocity is maximum at the lowest point.
Result: Her maximum velocity is 4 m s⁻¹ at the lowest position.
items.finalAnswer: 4 m s⁻¹, at the lowest position

steps: Given: Force, F = 50 N; angle with the horizontal, θ = 45°; displacement, s = 20 m.
Required: Work done, W.
Formula: W = Fs cos θ.
Substitution: W = 50 N × 20 m × cos 45°.
Working: W = 1000 J × 0.707 = 707 J (approximately).
Result: The work done is 707 J.
Given: Mass of box, m = 5 kg; length of inclined plane, s = 10 m; angle with the horizontal, θ = 30°; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻².
Required: Work done in pushing the box up the inclined plane, W.
Formula: W = Fs. For a frictionless inclined plane, F = mg sin θ; therefore W = mg s sin θ = mgh.
Substitution: W = 5 kg × 10 m s⁻² × 10 m × sin 30°.
Result: The work done is 250 J.
Given: Mass of box, m = 5 kg; length of inclined plane, s = 10 m; angle with the horizontal, θ = 30°; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻².
Required: Work done in lifting the box vertically, W.
Formula: W = mgh.
Substitution: h = s sin θ = 10 m × sin 30° = 5 m; W = 5 kg × 10 m s⁻² × 5 m.
Working: W = 250 J.
Result: The work done is 250 J.
Given: Mass of box, m = 10 kg; force applied, F = 80 N; distance moved along ramp, s = 15 m; vertical height, h = 5 m; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻².
Required: Efficiency of the system.
Formula: Efficiency = (useful output work / input work) × 100%.
Substitution: Input work = Fs = 80 N × 15 m = 1200 J. Useful output work = mgh = 10 kg × 10 m s⁻² × 5 m = 500 J.
Working: Efficiency = (500 J / 1200 J) × 100% = 41.7%.
Result: The efficiency of the system is 41.7%.
Given: Force, F = 600 N; displacement, s = 5 m; time, t = 15 s.
Required: Power, P.
Formula: P = W/t and W = Fs; therefore P = Fs/t.
Substitution: P = (600 N × 5 m) / 15 s.
Working: P = 3000 J / 15 s = 200 W.
Result: The power is 200 W.
Given: Mass of boy, m = 40 kg; vertical height, h = 10 m; time, t = 8 s; acceleration due to gravity, g = 10 m s⁻².
Required: Power developed, P.
Formula: P = W/t and W = mgh; therefore P = mgh/t.
Substitution: P = (40 kg × 10 m s⁻² × 10 m) / 8 s.
Working: P = 4000 J / 8 s = 500 W.
Result: The power developed is 500 W.
